title: Michael's regression: three creatures in front of the truck
summary: Michael Johnson tells of Michael's regression: three creatures in front of the truck, about November 1977 (regression 2026) at November 5 missile site, Ellsworth AFB, South Dakota, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: November 5 missile site, Ellsworth AFB, South Dakota

tellings.quote: Three creatures I never seen out of this whole world was in front of me.

plain: Michael Johnson, a former US Air Force guard, says that in November 1977 he was in a truck at a nuclear missile site called November 5, part of Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota. During a 2026 regression, a hypnosis session with Ivonne Smith meant to bring back buried memories, he said three creatures unlike anything in this world stood in front of the truck. He told it on the podcast of host Jesse Michels; if true, it would mean non-human beings confronted guards at a nuclear site.
